It continues through the call to the wilderness, Kedar, and Sela to raise their voices, closing at web:Isa.42.13, Yahweh will go out like a mighty man. He will stir up zeal like a man of war. He will raise a war cry. Yes, he will shout aloud. He will triumph over his enemies.. The unit finishes at oshb:Isa.42.13, and a SAMEKH parashah mark (single-witness) here backs up the boundary that precedes the divine first-person speech resuming at oshb:Isa.42.14.
